parallel.requirements: Recognized that the task required a from-scratch reimplementation based only on running the bundled executable and reading bundled documentation, with no source lookup or binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created local harness helpers, then delegated a 16-area behavioral exploration workflow with a critic pass while continuing local probes itself.
parallel.implementation: No replacement source, compile script, build system, or executable implementation was created; work stayed in behavioral probing and notes.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child findings were integrated into a product implementation; artifact validation showed notes plus original workspace files rather than a buildable reimplementation.
parallel.verification: The run used harness-based behavioral observations but never performed integrated verification of a new implementation; official evaluation reported compile_failed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with null result and the final artifact lacked implementation files, so all official tests were not run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same reverse-engineering prompt and constraints, including observing the executable through allowed interactions only.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled, the serial run kept all probing, harness changes, and deductions in one local parent trajectory.
serial.implementation: No replacement source, compile script, build system, or executable implementation was created; the run remained in exploratory probing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There were no child handoffs or component integrations; artifact validation showed only original workspace files and no new deliverable source.
serial.verification: The run gathered behavioral observations through local commands but never verified a produced implementation; official evaluation also reported compile_failed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial trajectory ended with exit 137 during probing and delivered no buildable solution, leaving all official tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the need to reimplement the compiled program from observed behavior only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received and followed the same prompt-level constraints for observation-only reverse engineering.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements difference is visible; both understood the task but stopped before implementing it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent decomposed exploration into 16 areas and a second critic stage under one workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows disabled and kept ownership in one process with no child delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used broad research fan-out; serial used a monolithic local probing strategy.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs targeted `/tmp/findings/<area>.md` files and critic append passes for behavioral facts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interfaces and maintained its findings in the parent trajectory and local harness state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a findings-file handoff surface, but no completed aggregate handoff reached the parent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created notes and harness scripts, then continued measuring behavior without writing replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial repeatedly adjusted its local harness and probed UI behavior without writing replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both stayed in exploration; parallel spent much of the path inside delegated workflow probes while serial stayed local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow result was null and killed, and parent-visible findings were empty when checked.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to join; the single trajectory ended with a failed local command at exit 137.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished delegated result lifecycle; serial had only local unfinished probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No concurrent implementation writes or merge conflicts were evidenced, and the final archive contained notes plus original files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No shared-state concurrency existed, and the final archive contained only original files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added harness notes to the artifact but did not integrate child findings into a replacement program; serial added no comparable files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel collected behavioral observations but never ran acceptance checks against a new build, and official evaluation failed at compile time.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise gathered observations only and official evaluation failed at compile time.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No verification advantage appeared in either mode; neither had a built implementation for tests to exercise.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recorded 44 subagents, 2,098,383 workflow child tokens, 620 child tool calls, timeout, and a killed workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no workflow child tokens or subagents and still reached the run limit during local probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a distinct budget pressure from excessive live fan-out; serial exhausted time through single-threaded exploration.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed evaluations are concordant failures: both modes have solution_passed false and compile_failed with 1232 tests not run. The concrete strategy difference is process-level, not outcome-level: parallel spent the run on a broad unfinished workflow, while serial spent it on one local probing stream.
parallel_contributors: Wide 16-area workflow plus critic stage consumed budget before implementation or integration could occur.
Final artifact lacked replacement source or buildable implementation files.
serial_contributors: Serial remained in local behavioral probing and ended before any implementation was produced.
Final artifact likewise lacked replacement source or buildable implementation files.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither attempt produced ordinary source code, a compile script, or an executable replacement, so compile failure was shared.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; retained pattern is an observed adverse parallel process consequence only.

candidates.reason: The overall prompt and parent retained responsibility for implementation; the failure was not an explicitly ownerless split but an overbroad probe workflow consuming the run.
No separate component implementations were produced, so there was no observed unowned integration step to reconcile completed parts.
No complete component set or executable replacement existed for final packaging, so assembly ownership was not the first concrete boundary.
The parent remained the end-to-end actor; the observed failure was the workflow allocation exhausting budget before the pipeline reached implementation.
The run was not blocked behind a single mandatory preflight oracle; it launched a broad multi-area workflow while the parent also continued local probing.
Parallel investigators overlapped, but the investigation phase never completed and the more specific fan-out budget exhaustion explains the realized process loss.
Implementation was displaced, but the evidence points to collective excessive breadth and retries, making Fan-out Budget Exhaustion the more specific allocation label.
The parent launched a 16-area workflow with a critic stage; the workflow was killed with null result after consuming large child token and tool budgets, leaving implementation work undone.
candidates.realized_consequence: The fan-out consumed the finite run window before implementation or aggregate findings were available, and the final artifact contained no replacement source or build deliverable.
candidates.near_match_reason: Investigation was not merely a completed first phase; the more specific observed event was excessive live fan-out and retry pressure exhausting budget before a return.

candidates.reason: No single child was shown to dominate the workflow; the adverse event came from the collective 16-area fan-out plus critic stage and stalled retries.
The child briefs included task rules, area scope, and deliverable expectations; no already-known requirement was shown omitted from a child brief and followed into unusable work.
Children were assigned behavioral research findings, not interoperating implementation components, and no incompatible independently produced parts appeared.
There is no evidence that a known finding was transferred and then lost; the workflow failed before a usable aggregate handoff reached the parent.
No large completed returned handoff is visible at a parent decision point; the relevant workflow result remained unavailable because the fan-out was killed.
No receiver acted on a superseded handoff; the record shows unfinished probing rather than stale transferred state.
No incompatible completed reports or contracts reached the parent and remained unadjudicated before closure.
The parent did not make an observable whole-task completion decision based on partial results; final output was empty and the artifact was simply incomplete.
Workflow retry and stall messages appear inside the same broad fan-out episode, but no replacement actor lacking inherited checkpoints is separately evidenced.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: Children were killed as part of the terminal timeout chain; there is no separate parent decision to stop a needed active child before a retrievable result.
No complete promotable implementation candidate or compatible component set existed, so late promotion or packaging is not established.
No child result or implementation change was merged after verification; no implementation merge occurred.
The delegated work was research and critic probing, not a completed delegated implementation awaiting parent adoption.
The critic/verifier stage did not produce a concrete completed finding trapped below the parent; its missing return is downstream of the killed fan-out.
There was no separate failed child with recoverable time for takeover; the workflow was killed at run closure as part of the fan-out budget episode.
No completed child result was visible and ignored by the parent; the checked findings directory was empty and the workflow returned null.
The parent did inspect progress and kept probing locally; the concrete cause was not passive waiting but a live workflow too broad for the run budget.
No concurrent implementation files with overlapping behavior or competing designs were produced.
No evidence shows two live actors editing the same source or configuration file and reconciling the conflict.
No non-entry source written by one actor was replaced or deleted by another actor.
No required executable or entry-point replacement was owned and overwritten by another actor.
No broad cleanup or promotion replaced another actor's final-tree work or provenance.
The workflow mostly targeted separate temporary findings files; no unstable shared implementation workspace write consequence is proven.
No generated temporary file, cache, tool, or auxiliary implementation from one actor was consumed by another as stable reference input.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent launched a 16-area exploration workflow with a critic stage. The workflow state shows it was killed with no result after large child-token and tool use, while parent-visible progress remained empty and no implementation was delivered.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The broad workflow consumed the finite run window before findings could be integrated or implementation could start, leaving the submitted artifact without replacement source or a buildable deliverable.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The issue was not simply sequencing investigation before implementation; the evidence shows collective live fan-out and retries exhausting the run budget before a workflow return.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Serial Investigation, Critical-Path Starvation, Early Child Termination, Missing Verifier Return, No Failure Takeover, and Blind Timeout Wait were treated as near or downstream descriptions of the same killed wide workflow rather than separate episodes.
Late Finalization and Missing Implementation Join were rejected because no complete implementation candidate or delegated implementation result existed to promote or join.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only Fan-out Budget Exhaustion cleared the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No additional labels were retained for the same timeout chain because they lacked distinct episode IDs, consequences, and corrective actions.
